mechanism: Establish one original clearly adult fighter, readable opponents and a stable combat geography before spectacle grows. Every decisive beat must follow the same causal order: an adult commits a visible physical trajectory, bodies or a prop make real contact, and only then a brief bounded energy, dust, hair, fabric or light reaction appears at the contact point. Keep the reaction shorter than the initiating action and preserve silhouettes throughout. Escalate through opponent count and reaction radius rather than pre-emptive projectiles. End by stopping all effects and holding the same adult in the established space. The reusable mechanism is physical action first, contact proof second, transient multimodal feedback third, controlled escalation and quiet reset—not the source people, gym, costumes, choreography, exact discharge design, creator identity or timing.

invariants.ablation_failure: Without the baseline, later light could be mistaken for the cause of motion.

invariants.rule: Require a visible committed trajectory and real contact before every energy reaction.

invariants.rule: Keep every reaction bounded to the contact point and shorter than the initiating action.
invariants.purpose: Makes spectacle support rather than replace choreography.
invariants.ablation_failure: Long full-frame blooms erase impact timing and body continuity.

invariants.rule: Escalate opponent count and reaction radius while keeping silhouettes and positions legible.
invariants.purpose: Raises intensity without abandoning the combat grammar.
invariants.ablation_failure: Random camera and effect growth becomes visual noise.

invariants.rule: Stop all effects and hold the same adult in the established space after the final exchange.
invariants.ablation_failure: An effect-only ending cannot show who remained or where.

slots.name: setting

slots.name: escalation_variable
slots.constraint: One causal variable that changes through visible stages.

slots.name: performance_rule
slots.constraint: A restrained acting or motion rule that keeps the mechanism legible.

slots.name: camera_grammar
slots.constraint: An information order that proves each state without copying source shot boundaries.

slots.name: payoff
slots.constraint: A clean final physical, informational or social consequence.

slots.name: sound_family
slots.constraint: An original hierarchy of diegetic cues; no unsupported source-audio claim.

anti_copy_exclusions: source woman, surrounding men, faces, bodies and gym clothing
source training hall, windows, floor and exact sunlight
source punches, kicks, blocks, falls and exact choreography
source white-blue discharge shape, dust density and lighting pulses
source camera path, timing, creator identity and Seedance 2.5 wording
